snippet.description:
Welcome to The Cottage Life — Where slow living meets self-reliance.

This is a place to be inspired by what's possible—growing real, nutrient-dense food year-round, no matter where you live.

From kitchen counters to cottage gardens, this channel celebrates the beauty of self-sufficiency, the peace of growing your own, and the quiet power of living in rhythm with the seasons.

Come for the inspiration. Stay for the shift.

snippet.title: Sheriff of Baghdad | John "Shrek" McPhee
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Sheriff of Baghdad's YouTube channel! 

My name is John McPhee, and I spent 20 years as a special missions operator in the US Army. I've carried out missions around the world in a variety of challenging environments, and now I'm retired from the military.

On this channel, I'll be sharing my training methods, life behind the scenes, and all the fun things I do on a daily basis. Expect to see me shooting guns, driving fast cars, blowing things up, and more. I'll also be visiting with specialists and manufacturers, testing out tactical gear, going hunting, and more. And if you're interested, you can even attend one of my training courses at a range near you!

So buckle up and join me on this wild ride. Fearlessness is mandatory, and seat belts are optional. I can't wait to share my adventures with you!

snippet.title: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools
snippet.description:
Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools (CMS) strives to create an innovative, inclusive, student-centered environment that supports the development of independent learners. In addition, CMS leads the community in educational excellence, inspiring intellectual curiosity, creativity, and achievement so that all students reach their full potential.

CMS is located in the Charlotte, North Carolina region and provides academic instruction, rigor and support each school day to more than 141,000 students in kindergarten through 12th grade in 185 schools throughout the cities and towns of Mecklenburg County. CMS believes setting high standards for all students creates a greater opportunity for future success – in our communities, within the region and across our diverse and global society. As a result, CMS students are prepared to be leaders in a technologically savvy and globally competitive world each day.

snippet.title: Home To Alaska
snippet.description:
Inspiring others by sharing our family's journey of returning back to Alaska and building a homestead from scratch.

Hi, my name is Anna. Me and my husband Gordon grew up in the interior of Alaska. When we had family move out of state, we decided to go too. But after spending a few years in South Carolina we started to miss our Alaskan life. So we packed up our things and our 4 children, and drove back over 5,000 miles to start over in our home state.

Our new homestead begins with us purchasing some raw Alaskan land on the Kenai Peninsula and taking apart an old house to build our cabin!

I hope you stick around and that our videos bring hope and inspiration to you and your family!

God bless,
Anna


email:  home2alaskafamily@gmail.com

If you'd like to send something please email us at the email above for the address 🙃




#homesteading #alaska #lifestyle #offgrid #frugal #familyfriendly #homesteadvlog #lifeinalaska

snippet.title: Capital Raccoon
snippet.description:
Budget prepping, tested — not theorized.
Capital Raccoon researches, price-checks and stress-tests everyday items from Walmart, Dollar Tree,
Costco and your own kitchen to find out what actually performs in an emergency — and what's a waste
of money. Every video is independently researched, scripted and produced: real prices, real shelf-life
data, real failure points.
No $500 tactical fantasy kits. No fear-selling. Just the math of being ready on a normal person's budget.
New videos weekly. Researched, written and produced by one person — a regular guy on a regular budget, testing what actually works.

snippet.title: The Gray Bearded Green Beret
snippet.description:
I'm Joshua Enyart, a former Army Ranger and Green Beret. I teach a logical, systems-based approach to survival and preparedness that will develop your tactical, bushcraft, and primitive skills so that you'll always be adequately prepared no matter what tools are at your disposal. 

I believe that with the proper mindset, application of knowledge, and practice, I can prepare you for any situation — ranging from emergency survival with your ultra-light bugout bag to 100% off-grid with no kit but wood, stone, and bone. And, in the meantime, I want to help you to have fun in the woods.

- Joshua, The Gray Bearded Green Beret

snippet.title: When It Hits
snippet.description:
When It Hits is a survival and preparedness channel built around two characters — Ghost, a crisis analyst who breaks down the logic behind every scenario, and The Old Wolf, who shows you exactly what to do and how to do it.
Together they walk you through everything you actually need to know — from building your first bug out bag to surviving long-term when the grid goes down. No panic, no drama. Just clear, practical information delivered in a way that sticks.
📋 What you'll find here:
🔹 Bug out plans and evacuation strategies
🔹 Survival gear — what's worth it and what isn't
🔹 Grid-down and SHTF scenarios broken down step by step
🔹 Skills, mindset, and real preparedness for real situations
Ghost explains the why. The Old Wolf shows you the how.
Between the two of them — you'll be ready.

Some people wait until something happens. We'd rather you were ready before it does.
